body.p: Claims 1-20 were pending in the application and claims 11-20 stand rejected. Claims 1- 10 are allowed. By this paper, the Specification and claims 11 and 15-16 have been amended. The amendments to the Specification and claims 11 and 15-16 are fully supported by the original disclosure, and thus, no new matter has been added. Reconsideration and withdrawal of the rejections are hereby respectfully solicited in view of the foregoing amendments and the following remarks.
Applicants have amended the Specification to correct the informalities in paragraph [0112]. No new matter has been added.
Applicants respectfully request that the amendments to the Specification be entered.

Claims 11-20 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. 112(b) or 35 U.S.C. 112 (pre-AIA), second paragraph, as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter which the inventor or a joint inventor (or for applications subject to pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 112, the applicant), regards as the invention. In particular, the body of the claim fails to positively recite a controlling step.

The examiner suggests amending the claim to include the step of "performing avoidance control or warning control based on the determined collision risk in order to claims 11-20 in condition for allowance. (See, Office Action, pp. 2-4).
Without conceding the veracity of the rejections, it is believed that the current

amendments, made for the sole purpose of advancing prosecution, render the rejections moot. In particular, amended claim 11 now recite "performing the avoidance control or the warning control based on the determined collision risk." Support for the amendment can be found in at least paragraphs [0115]-[0119] and FIG. 3 of the Application.
In light of the amendments and corresponding descriptions in the Application, Applicants respectfully request that the rejection of claims 11-20 be withdrawn.
Accordingly, Applicants respectfully submit that claims 11-20 are now in condition for allowance.

Reconsideration and withdrawal of the rejections are hereby respectfully solicited in view of the foregoing. The examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at the telephone number listed below in order to discuss any remaining issues or matters of form that will place this case in condition for allowance.
If the Office deems that additional fees are required, the Office is authorized to charge any such fees, either for this action or for any future action, to Deposit Account No. 50-3866.
